title: Sally A NDE 7265
content: I went out with friends for the day. We did consume a lot of alcohol but nothing more than we had previous times. We had a great, fulfilled day. In the early hours of the morning, we went back to their home. We had just arrived when I collapsed. I remember not being able to breathe. I heard my friend from what seemed like a long distance away. She was screaming and talking. I couldn't move or tell them I couldn't breathe. She struck her fingers down my throat to make me vomit. I started feeling extremely cold and saw a ray of sunlight. I started recalling events in my life in flashes. I remember thinking I must vomit all the vile out my life before getting near the warm light. I just wanted to reach the light. I was extremely cold but not panicky anymore. After vomiting, I got so very close to touching the sunray. All I felt was extreme bliss, peace, love, and so much warmth. I felt myself exhaling my last breath. I was completely at peace and felt a joy that I cannot describe. As I touched the sunray, I felt my lungs filled with air and I heard my friend calling my name. I was angry with her. I wanted to go back to the sunray. That's all I was thinking about. I woke the next morning and vividly remembered, very clearly. I think of the bliss and warm light even now, a week after it happened. I feel everything before going to sleep. My friend and I didn't discuss it much. I just told her I felt my last breath leave and was cold. She told me I went blue and that she did CPR on me. Apparently, I stopped breathing twice.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Collapsed after heavy alcohol consumption; could not breathe; friend reported she performed CPR and that the experiencer stopped breathing twice.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Breathing difficulty and vomiting; felt extremely cold; touched a ray of sunlight and experienced bliss/peace/love/warmth; then heard friend calling name and returned.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Cold/immobility and hearing friend screaming; life events recalled in flashes; then moved toward/touched a sunray (warm light) with bliss; then heard friend calling name and returned to breathing.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Interpreted vomiting as purging 'all the vile out my life' before getting near the warm light (sunray).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I started recalling events in my life in flashes.” “All I felt was extreme bliss, peace, love, and so much warmth.” “I felt myself exhaling my last breath.” “I was angry with her. I wanted to go back to the sunray.”
